Meri Jaan ke liye

Happy Birthday, Alara. ❤️

Aap mere liye bohat special ho, aur meri dua hai ke aapka yeh birthday aapko khush hone ki bohat si wajahen de. Aapki zindagi sukoon se bhari rahe, aapka dil mohabbat se aur aapki zindagi khoobsurat yaadon se bhari rahe. Aur jo bhi khwab aap dil mein rakhti ho, woh dheere dheere haqeeqat bante jayen. ✨

Bas itna yaad rakhna ke aap aaj hi nahi, har din khushi, mohabbat aur appreciation ki haqdar ho. Jaisi ho waisi hi khoobsurat rehna, aur kabhi mat bhoolna ke aap mere liye kitni precious ho.

Happy Birthday, Meri Jaan. Dua hai aapki zindagi ka yeh naya saal khoobsurat, sukoon bhara aur aapke dil ki har pyari si dua se bhi zyada haseen ho. ❤️
